title: Zen Tubing - South Asheville

services.name: Zen Tubing
services.desc: Zen Tubing offers an unforgettable river adventure on this pristine section of the French Broad River, located just minutes upstream from downtown Asheville. This beautiful stretch of water winds through parts of the Pisgah National Forest and flows serenely past the Biltmore Estate. As you float, keep an eye out for native wildlife-river otters, bald eagles, deer along the banks, and trout gliding through the waters are common sights, adding to the magic of the experience. The average float time with Zen Tubing is approximately 2 hours, though this may vary depending on river conditions such as water levels and wind. For a relaxed experience, we recommend planning for a leisurely float
